method: Per request, from the rollout's token_count records: uncached input = input - cached input; output includes reasoning. A request whose input exceeds 272K tokens is priced at the long-context rates; all others at the short-context rates. No cache writes were reported.

records.note: The largest single request carried 308,123 input tokens. The pricing page does not say whether the long-context rate applies per request or to a whole session; per request is used here. Failed or retried transport attempts during the network outages are not in the usage records.
